title: abelicea crenata
intro: Abelicea crenata, commonly known as Chinese Abelmoschus, is a plant species in the mallow family, Malvaceae. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Abelicea crenata are attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin diseases. The bioactive constituents of Abelicea crenata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
